description: This source file contains unit tests for the Orleans SiloBuilder, verifying configuration validation, service registration, and silo initialization behaviors. It also includes a stub implementation of IMembershipTable for testing purposes.

classes.name: NoOpMembershipTable
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of IMembershipTable used for testing silo configuration without requiring actual membership table infrastructure. Implements methods to simulate membership table behaviors with minimal logic.

classes.name: SiloBuilderTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the Orleans SiloBuilder, covering configuration validation, service registration, and startup behaviors.

methods.name: SiloBuilderTest
methods.description: Verifies that a silo can be successfully built and started with localhost clustering and essential configuration.

methods.name: SiloBuilder_GrainCollectionOptionsForZeroSecondsAgeLimitTest
methods.description: Ensures that configuring a GrainCollectionOptions with a zero seconds age limit throws an OrleansConfigurationException.

methods.name: SiloBuilder_ClusterMembershipOptionsValidators
methods.description: Ensures that invalid ClusterMembershipOptions configurations (e.g., NumVotesForDeathDeclaration >= NumProbedSilos) throw exceptions.

methods.name: SiloBuilder_LoadSheddingValidatorAbove100ShouldFail
methods.description: Validates that setting LoadSheddingOptions.CpuThreshold above 100 results in an OrleansConfigurationException.

methods.name: SiloBuilderThrowsDuringStartupIfNoGrainsAdded
methods.description: Checks that starting a silo without registered grain classes or interfaces throws an exception.

methods.name: SiloBuilderThrowsDuringStartupIfClientBuildersAdded
methods.description: Verifies that configuring both client and silo in the same host throws an OrleansConfigurationException.

methods.name: SiloBuilderWithHotApplicationBuilderThrowsDuringStartupIfClientBuildersAdded
methods.description: Similar to above, but with the Host.CreateApplicationBuilder API, confirming the restriction.
